author: Thomas_Shoes
body:
I got banned a moment ago for suicide encouragement...

I either said this as a joke, it was taken out of context, or it was a mistake.

Stimulating banned me, but when we were on together I didn't encourage suicide at all.

Can someone post the evidence?

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
Honestly, I am absolutely tired of your behavior. You were granted an appeal previously, on the condition that you respected our rules and policies, and played on the server appropriately. Looking through your logs, I can clearly see obvious suicide encouragement comments coming from you. Not to mention seconds after you were banned, you immediately ban evaded on your alternate account and continued to put racism comments in chat.

I am disgusted to have players like yourself on the server, and you will have no chance of appealing any of your bans in the future. 


Regards,
Arigenn, Administrator
